description: Photograph of two young children staged in a mock occult-ritual scene on a tiled floor. A red pentagram is drawn or taped on the tiles with lit candles at its points; one child in a black hooded robe kneels on a cushion holding an ornate dagger point-down, while a second child in a white dress lies smiling on her back across the pentagram with arms outstretched. Both children are smiling, giving the image the appearance of a staged or costume photo. The archive filename associates the image with 'Rachel Chandler' (post 3155), but nothing in the image itself supports any identification.
